main.description: An admin granting a member access at a tier, written to the registry space by approveMember. Append-only: re-granting writes a new record and a member is active iff there is a grant with no later revocation. The rkey is {memberDid}:{tid}, so the subject and the ordering resolve from a listing without fetching each record. Consumers MUST read these from the registry space, never from the firehose index: the collection is public-shaped, so anyone can publish a record of this type to their own PDS and have it indexed. Space membership is what makes a grant authoritative.

status.description: Always 'active'. A grant is never edited to revoke; revocation is a separate record.

tier.description: The member's tier, as an SCN-owned slug: level-0 (free) through level-9. Required, and enforced at write time — an absent or empty tier is a fail-open bug, because a consumer that emits an empty group claim causes Open WebUI to remove nothing and the member silently keeps their previous tier. A slug rather than an integer because level-0 is the most common tier and 0 is falsy in JavaScript. This exact string is what an Open WebUI group must be named, so the binding is greppable rather than hidden in a format string; human-readable display names map from it and never replace it.
